title: ehrlich-b/composition-algebras
abstract: Hurwitz's theorem (1898), classification form: a nontrivial finite-dimensional Euclidean composition algebra over R - a unital, not necessarily associative or commutative bilinear product together with a symmetric positive-definite form whose quadratic form is multiplicative - is isomorphic to R, C, the quaternions or the octonions, by a linear isomorphism preserving the unit, the product and the norm form. All four targets are constructed, with Degen's eight-square identity discharging the octonion composition law, so every branch of the conclusion is attained. Machine checked, not peer reviewed, no priority claim.
